## Setup

**New here?** The addon only shows tries that already reached
[Quagorious](https://quagorious.gg), so set up the Quagorious Uploader first.
The guide walks through arcdps, the uploader, installing this DLL and
connecting it:
**[English](https://github.com/quagorious/nexus/blob/main/docs/en/README.md)** ·
**[Deutsch](https://github.com/quagorious/nexus/blob/main/docs/de/README.md)**

Download `quagorious_share.dll` below and copy it into `Guild Wars 2/addons/`.
If you already have the addon, Nexus updates it by itself.
